description_expanded:
Watersound Crossings

Gulf-front, panoramic views!

Private beach!

3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths

Community pool!

Gated community with 24/7 on-site security

4-star restaurants

The Crossings at Watersound Beach C214 by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Wake up to sweeping Gulf views and the soothing sound of waves. In one of 30A’s most exclusive communities, this elegant 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath condo at WaterSound Crossings offers front-row seats to sugar-white sand and endless blue horizons. The private, oversized balcony is an amazing space. Sip coffee as the sun rises or unwind with a glass of wine while the sky shifts to shades of orange, pink, and gold. Honey, is that a dolphin? Inside, natural light pours through floor-to-ceiling windows, highlighting a thoughtfully designed space that’s both stylish and comfortable. A plush wrap-around sofa offers plenty of room to lounge, while the chef’s kitchen, equipped with premium appliances and sleek countertops, makes mealtime effortless.

The dining table and breakfast bar provide seating for eight, making it easy to gather and share the day’s best moments. The spacious primary suite features a king bed and a spa-like bath with a deep soaking tub and separate shower. Two guest suites, each with a queen bed and private bath, provide peaceful retreats, with one offering a breathtaking view. Very nice. At Oversee 30A, our local team is here to ensure your stay is seamless. Have a question? Need assistance? We’re close by and always ready to help, with support available seven days a week and a 24/7 emergency line for peace of mind. Overview: - Gulf-front - 2286 sq. ft. - Private Beach - 3 Bedroom, 3.5 Bath - Gulf Views - Community Pool - Does not include designated parking spaces. However, up to two vehicles are permitted to enter the community and may park on a first-come, first-served basis. -Exciting news from WaterSound! The WaterSound Crossings condominiums are set to undergo a stunning exterior renovation in 2026. Get ready to see a refreshed look that enhances this beautiful community. Overnight: - Primary Suite: King bed, oversized ensuite bath, deep soaker tub, walk-in shower, TV - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, ensuite bathroom, TV - Guest Bedroom: Queen bed, ensuite bathroom, TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
